newsitem.title: UK: Brazil to launch $750 mln five-year global bond. [CORRECTED 20:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Brazil to launch $750 mln five-year global bond. [CORRECTED 20:45 GMT]

text.p: (Lead managers correct to delete reference to bond's maturity, originally given as five years. The lead managers now say the maturity has not yet been determined.)
Brazil will launch a $750 million global bond, joint lead managers J.P. Morgan and SBC Warburg said on Friday.
Roadshows for the deal will be held during the week starting October 21 and presentations will be made in Asia, Europe and U.S., they said.
